title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance / Senior Finance Manager 
 Company: SD Group
 Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu
 Experience: 8-10 Years
 Industry: Service & Manufacturing
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Reports To: GM Finance & Accounts 
 Job Summary: 
 We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Finance / Senior Finance Manager to lead our finance and accounting functions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in financial planning, reporting, budgeting, taxation, compliance, cost management, and strategic financial decision-making. The candidate will be responsible for providing financial insights to management, ensuring financial discipline and compliance, improving operational efficiency, and leading the finance team effectively. Key Requirements 
 Education: B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter / equivalent qualification MBA in Finance will be an added advantage Experience: 8-10 years of progressive experience, with a minimum of 5 years in a financial leadership/managerial role Experience in Service and Manufacturing industries preferred Strong knowledge of Direct Taxation (Income Tax) and Indirect Taxation (GST) Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, accounting standards, compliance frameworks, and company law procedures Proficiency in ERP systems, financial modelling, MIS and financial analytics Strong strategic, analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent leadership, communication and interpersonal skills Proficiency in Tamil and English Work Location: Chennai Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Strategic Financial Leadership Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with the organization's long-term business objectives. Provide financial insights and recommendations to the management on business performance, risks and opportunities. Drive initiatives to improve profitability, cash flow and operational efficiency. Support management in strategic financial decision-making. 
 2. Financial Reporting & Analysis Oversee the preparation of financial statements, including Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Statement and Cash Flow Statement . Ensure accurate and timely preparation of MIS and financial reports. Monitor receivables, collections and outstanding payments . Provide data-driven financial analysis and insights to management and stakeholders. Monitor key financial performance indicators and identify areas requiring corrective action. 
 3. Budgeting & Forecasting Lead the annual budgeting and financial forecasting process. Ensure budgets are aligned with organizational goals and business plans. Monitor actual performance against budgets and analyse variances. Recommend corrective measures to control costs and improve financial performance. 
 4. Cost & Efficiency Management Develop and implement effective cost-control measures. Monitor project costs, operational expenses and overheads. Identify opportunities for cost reduction and improved profitability. Strengthen financial controls and improve overall operational efficiency. 
 5. Taxation & Compliance Ensure timely and accurate compliance with Income Tax, GST and other applicable statutory requirements . Coordinate with auditors, consultants and statutory authorities as required. Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, financial regulations and company law procedures. Maintain proper documentation and financial records. 
 6. Team Leadership & Development Lead, manage and mentor the finance and accounting team. Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance. Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback. Develop team capabilities through training and professional development. Foster a culture of accountability, accuracy and continuous improvement. Reporting Structure Reports To: GM Finance & Accounts
 Works Closely With: Top Management / Key Stakeholders Preferred Candidate Profile Candidates with strong experience in Finance & Accounts, Financial Planning & Analysis, MIS, Budgeting, Taxation, GST, Income Tax, Cost Control, Auditing, Compliance and Team Management are preferred. Interested candidates with relevant experience and qualifications may share their updated CV at: 
 hr@spacedraft.in

title: Finance Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities VPRC is looking for a dynamic and experienced Manager Finance to manage the company's day-to-day financial operations, cash flow, fund allocation, accounting, budgeting, financial reporting and internal controls. 
 The role will be responsible for ensuring financial discipline, optimum utilization of funds, timely reporting and effective financial controls, while providing accurate financial information to management for business decision-making. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Fund & Cash Flow Management Monitor VPRC's daily cash position and fund requirements. Prepare regular cash flow statements and forecasts. Plan and monitor fund allocation based on business priorities. Ensure optimum utilization of available funds. Monitor incoming and outgoing payments and maintain adequate liquidity. Identify potential cash-flow gaps and escalate them to management. Coordinate with management for major financial commitments and payments. 
 2. Financial Accounting & Reporting Supervise day-to-day accounting activities. Ensure accurate and timely recording of all financial transactions. Review ledgers, bank reconciliations and accounting entries. Ensure timely month-end and year-end closing. Prepare monthly financial statements and management reports. Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation. 
 3. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare monthly Finance MIS for management review. Provide reports on revenue, expenses, cash flow, receivables and payables. Prepare budget-versus-actual analysis. Highlight significant financial variances and cost deviations. Provide financial data and analysis to support management decisions. 
 4. Budgeting & Cost Control Assist in preparation of the annual financial budget. Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets. Identify unnecessary expenditure and cost-control opportunities. Ensure expenses are incurred within approved limits and authorization processes. Review major expenditure proposals from a financial perspective. 
 5. Receivables & Payables Management Monitor outstanding receivables and payment collections. Prepare and review ageing reports. Coordinate with relevant teams regarding overdue payments. Monitor vendor liabilities and payment schedules. Ensure payments are planned according to cash availability and business priorities. 
 6. Internal Financial Controls Implement and monitor effective financial control procedures. Ensure proper authorization for expenses, purchases and payments. Verify supporting documents before processing financial transactions. Identify financial control gaps and recommend corrective measures. Ensure adherence to VPRC's finance policies and approval procedures. 
 7. Audit & Statutory Compliance Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors and consultants. Ensure timely preparation of audit schedules and supporting documents. Support statutory compliance relating to GST, TDS, income tax and other applicable requirements. Ensure timely closure of audit observations. Maintain proper documentation for statutory and financial records. 
 8. Banking & Treasury Operations Manage banking transactions and relationships with banks. Monitor bank balances, payments and collections. Review bank reconciliations and resolve discrepancies. Coordinate with banks for routine financial requirements. Monitor interest costs, banking charges and other financial expenses. 
 9. Team Management Supervise the Finance & Accounts team. Allocate responsibilities and monitor deliverables. Establish timelines for accounting, reconciliations, MIS and reporting. Ensure accuracy and timely completion of finance activities. Develop a culture of financial discipline and process adherence. 
 Key Deliverables Accurate and timely monthly Finance MIS. Effective cash-flow monitoring and forecasting. Proper fund allocation and utilization. Timely accounting and financial closing. Strong receivables and payables monitoring. Effective budget and cost control. Robust internal financial controls. Timely statutory and audit compliance. Reliable financial information for management. 
 Qualification Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory Candidates who have completed their CA qualification with relevant post-qualification experience will be preferred. Strong knowledge of accounting standards, taxation, financial reporting, cash-flow management and financial controls is essential. 
 Experience 15 to 20 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably with significant post-qualification experience as a Chartered Accountant. Proven experience in fund management, cash-flow planning, budgeting, MIS, financial reporting and internal controls. Experience independently managing finance operations and working closely with senior management is preferred. 
 CORE COMPETENCIES Fund Management & Cash Flow Planning Financial Planning & Analysis Budgeting & Cost Control Financial Reporting & MIS Working Capital Management Statutory Compliance & Taxation Internal Controls & Audit Banking & Treasury Operations Financial Risk Management Advanced MS Excel and ERP/Accounting Systems Strong analytical and commercial understanding High level of integrity, accuracy and financial discipline 

 Preferred candidate profile 
 Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be a hands-on finance professional who can independently manage VPRC's financial operations, maintain strong financial controls, provide clear MIS to management and ensure that funds are planned, allocated and utilized efficiently. The candidate should have the ability to identify financial risks early, bring discipline to financial processes and support management with accurate, timely and actionable financial information.

Key Skills: Budgetary Control,Strategic Financial Planning,Funds Flow Management,Cash Flow Management,Financial Management,Fund Management,Budget Management,Cost Planning

Assist in documentation and provide data/support for internal and external audits. Take ownership of assigned processes and ensure timely resolution of escalations.

Strong working knowledge of MS Excel ; familiarity with Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, filters, and basic formulas is preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. A Day in the Life The Strategic Key Accounts team is responsible for developing and expanding relationships with large, complex healthcare organizations and strategic customers. This function partners across commercial, marketing, and business unit teams to align account strategies with customer priorities, identify growth opportunities, and support long-term business partnerships. The role focuses on portfolio growth, market share expansion, strategic account planning, and value-based customer engagement. 
This position is based in Chennai, India and operates in a remote work environment. The role requires approximately 30% travel to customer sites, internal meetings, and key stakeholder engagements across the assigned territory. 
Job Description field
The Strategic Key Accounts Manager is responsible for managing strategic healthcare accounts, building executive-level customer relationships, and driving business growth through account planning, portfolio expansion, and commercial execution. This role collaborates with internal stakeholders and customer leadership teams to identify opportunities, develop account-specific strategies, and support achievement of business objectives across assigned accounts. 
 Primary Responsibilities Develop and maintain relationships with senior executives and key decision-makers within strategic healthcare accounts. Create and execute account plans aligned with customer priorities, business objectives, and growth targets. Identify, qualify, and advance new business opportunities within assigned strategic accounts. Collaborate with business units, marketing, and cross-functional teams to implement account strategies and customer programs. Analyze customer needs, market dynamics, and competitive activity to recommend solutions that support account growth. Negotiate and support long-term contractual agreements that strengthen customer relationships and expand portfolio adoption. Monitor account performance, sales results, and opportunity pipelines to achieve revenue and market share objectives. Provide customer and market insights to support strategic planning, pricing discussions, and business decision-making. Required Qualifications High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 10+ years experience OR Associate s Degree AND 8+ years experience OR Bachelor s Degree AND 6+ years experience. Experience managing strategic or enterprise-level customer accounts with responsibility for revenue growth and relationship management. Experience engaging with C-suite executives, hospital leadership teams, and procurement stakeholders. Experience developing and executing account plans, business reviews, and customer engagement strategies. Demonstrated ability to influence senior customer stakeholders and manage complex sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers. Willingness and ability to travel up to 30% within the assigned territory. Preferred Qualifications Experience working within the medical device, healthcare technology, life sciences, or healthcare services industry. Demonstrated success leading complex negotiations and supporting contractual business agreements. Experience collaborating across multiple business units and cross-functional teams to deliver customer solutions. Knowledge of healthcare market trends, hospital operations, and strategic account management methodologies. of relevant sales and leadership experience. Physical Job Requirements

As a Purchase Professional, you will exhibit a strong work ethic and demonstrate exceptional proficiency in ensuring detailed and efficient procurement processes, enabling us to challenge in the global market. 
 In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Research and identify suitable suppliers to meet the part specification needs. Evaluate supplier performance based on quality, cost, and delivery reliability. Ensuring all invoices are sent to accounts for payment process after good receipt. Resolve issues such as delays, defective products, or incorrect shipments. Maintenance of purchase records and vendor performance records/data. Ensure accuracy and timely Attribute study and setting in Oracle system. Effective co-ordination with Global Supply Chain (GSC) team across the world and align to their vendor management policies and consistent vendor performance. Align materials as per Oracle Demand date, synchronized receipt of materials & in turn support in meeting customer delivery dates. To review and set purchase policies on requirements of material from time to time and develop and maintain good buyer-seller (Vendor) relationship. Loading the foundry based on the RCCP tonnage allocated to each foundry as per GSC Guidelines. Analysis on Loading pattern based on Supplier performance of each vendor and surge loading of vendor based upon the project order flow in previous month. Submitting all transporter bills on time to Payable team and Tracking all transport payment, the NSDJ progress which is created to stock transfer of D-excess parts. Maintaining all Purchase metrics data - OTD, PPM and spent analysis report. Identifying the D-excess parts and allocating them to the current demand with approval from QC. Review and clearance of Vendor invoices for on time payment processing. 
 Who We Are: You act with a clear sense of ownership, build and deliver solutions that meet customer expectations, establish and maintain effective customer relationships and credit others for their contributions and accomplishments. 
 For This Role, You Will Need: Degree or equivalent experience or experience in Engineering and 5+ years Material Planning & Purchasing experience. title: Team Lead - Finance @Medmetrix
description:
Greetings from Medmetrix!!! 
 We have an excellent opening for the role Team Lead - Finance at our organisation. 
 Interested candidates can share their updated resume to hgayathri@med-metrix.com 
 Department: Finance & Accounts
 Reporting To: International Controller / CFO
 Employment Type: Full-Time | Permanent
 Experience: 5 - 8 Years 
 About the Role 
 We are seeking a highly driven and detail-oriented Team Lead Finance to oversee end-to-end finance and accounting operations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for financial reporting, month-end closures, budgeting, reconciliations, compliance, process improvement, and team management while ensuring adherence to accounting standards and organizational policies. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Financial Accounting 
 Manage day-to-day accounting operations and ensure accurate financial recording. Review journal entries, accruals, provisions, prepayments, and adjustments. Monitor and maintain General Ledger (GL) integrity. Conduct periodic ledger reviews and resolve discrepancies. Ensure compliance with accounting standards and internal policies. 
 Month-End & Year-End Closures 
 Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities. Prepare and review schedules, reconciliations, and closing reports. Ensure timely accounting of depreciation, accruals, provisions, and adjustments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely closure of financial activities. Support statutory and management reporting requirements. 
 Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable 
 Oversee AP & AR processes, invoice validation, and payment cycles. Monitor vendor and customer outstanding balances. Review aging reports and drive timely collections and settlements. Resolve invoice and payment-related issues with stakeholders. Track advances and ensure timely adjustments. 
 Reconciliations & Financial Controls 
 Review bank reconciliations and balance sheet schedules. Investigate and resolve reconciling items and aged balances. Ensure proper supporting documentation for all balance sheet accounts. Strengthen financial controls and compliance practices. 
 MIS & Financial Reporting 
 Prepare and analyze financial MIS reports and dashboards. Provide insights on revenue, expenses, profitability, and working capital. Perform budget vs actual and variance analysis. Support management with actionable financial insights and recommendations. 
 Budgeting & Forecasting 
 Support annual budgeting and operating plan processes. Coordinate with business stakeholders during budget preparation. Monitor business performance against approved budgets. Prepare monthly and quarterly forecasts. Identify cost optimization opportunities and support strategic decision-making. 
 Compliance & Audit Management 
 Ensure compliance with company policies, SOPs, and internal controls. Support internal, statutory, and external audits. Prepare audit schedules and provide required documentation. Track and close audit observations within agreed timelines. Drive adherence to authorization controls and governance frameworks. 
 Process Improvement & Automation 
 Identify opportunities to streamline accounting and finance processes. Drive automation initiatives and reduce manual interventions. Improve reporting efficiency and turnaround times. Collaborate with ERP/IT teams for system enhancements. 
 Team Leadership 
 Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team. Allocate work, monitor productivity, and ensure quality deliverables. Establish timelines for recurring finance activities. Drive team capability building and succession planning. Ensure business continuity for critical finance operations. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Timely and accurate month-end closure
 Accuracy of financial statements and MIS reports
 Completion of account reconciliations within deadlines
 Reduction in aged/open accounting items
 Efficient invoice and payment processing
 Budget adherence and cost control effectiveness
 Timely audit support and closure of audit findings
 Continuous process improvement and automation
 Team productivity and people development 
 Desired Candidate Profile 
 Qualifications 
 MBA (Finance) / M.Com / B.Com or equivalent qualification. Professional certifications such as CA Inter, CMA, ACCA (preferred but not mandatory). 
 Experience 
 5 to 8 years of experience in Finance & Accounts. Strong expertise in: Financial Accounting General Ledger Management Financial Reporting & MIS Month-End Closures Reconciliations Budgeting & Forecasting Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, NetSuite, or similar. Prior experience managing or mentoring finance teams will be an added advantage. 
 Key Skills 
 Finance & Accounts | Financial Reporting | General Ledger | AP & AR | Balance Sheet Reconciliation | Bank Reconciliation | MIS Reporting | Budgeting | Forecasting | Variance Analysis | Internal Controls | Audit Support | Month-End Closure | ERP Systems (SAP/Oracle/Dynamics) | Team Management | Process Improvement | Financial Analysis | Stakeholder Management 
 Why Join Us? Opportunity to work closely with global finance leadership. Exposure to strategic finance initiatives and business partnering. Collaborative work environment with strong growth opportunities. Platform to lead process transformation and automation initiatives. 
 If you are a finance professional with strong accounting expertise and leadership capabilities, we'd love to hear from you! 
 Regards, Harshini - HR Talent Acquisition Hgayathri@med-metrix.com

title: Manager - Internal Auditor (Corporate Role)
description:
Job description: 
 Larsen & Toubro Ltd, commonly known as L&T, is an Indian multinational conglomerate company, with business interests in engineering, construction, manufacturing, technology, information technology and financial services, headquartered in Mumbai. The company is counted among world's top five construction companies. 
 The L&T Group comprises of 93 subsidiaries, 5 associate companies, 27 joint ventures and 35 jointly held operations, operating across basic and heavy engineering, construction, realty, manufacturing of capital goods, information technology, and financial services. 
 Job Role: Internal Auditor 
 This role is based out of Chennai. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Audit Planning: Develop and implement risk-based internal audit plans for project operations. Identify key risks associated with project execution, including financial, operational, and compliance risks. Design audit scopes, objectives, and timelines for reviewing projects. 
 Internal Control Evaluation: Assess the effectiveness and efficiency of internal controls related to project activities, including procurement, budgeting, financial reporting, and resource allocation. Identify weaknesses in controls and recommend improvements. 
 Project Financial Audits: Review financial records of projects to ensure accuracy and compliance with accounting standards. Conduct audits of project budgets, funding, cost allocation, and expenditure. Monitor adherence to contractual obligations and project funding agreements. 
 Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure that project activities comply with relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies. Identify potential risks in project management processes and suggest strategies to mitigate them. Conduct audits related to regulatory compliance, contract management, and external reporting requirements. 
 Project Performance Audits: Evaluate the performance of projects, ensuring that objectives are being met within budget, timeline, and scope. Review the efficiency of project resource utilization (staff, equipment, etc.). Conduct post-implementation audits to assess the success and sustainability of projects. 
 Reporting and Recommendations: Prepare audit reports with findings, conclusions, and recommendations for management. Present audit results to project managers, senior leadership, and other stakeholders. Follow up on audit recommendations to ensure corrective actions are implemented. 
 Advisory and Improvement Initiatives: Provide consultative support to project teams to strengthen internal controls and enhance risk management strategies. Offer insights for process improvements and opportunities for cost-saving and efficiency in project management. 
 Coordination and Collaboration: Collaborate with project managers, finance teams, and other stakeholders to gather audit evidence and ensure transparency. Work closely with external auditors where necessary, providing required documentation and insights. 
 Documentation and Record-Keeping: Maintain thorough documentation of audit processes, findings, and follow-up actions. Ensure all audit work is conducted in accordance with established standards, guidelines, and best practices. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications: 
 Education: CA Compulsory 
 Experience: Proven experience (7-12 years) in internal auditing, preferably within project-driven environments (e.g., construction, IT, engineering). Familiarity with project management methodologies such as Agile, PRINCE2, or PMP is advantageous. 
 Technical Skills: Strong understanding of internal control frameworks, audit techniques, and risk management principles. Proficient in audit software and ERP systems. Strong knowledge of accounting standards (GAAP, IFRS) and regulatory requirements. 
 Work Environment: This position will require travel to project sites for on-site audits (2 weeks in a month). The auditor should be comfortable working in a dynamic project environment with multiple ongoing initiatives.

description:
J
 **ob Description** 




 This role is primarily focused on FP\&A, pricing analysis, financial modeling, and scenario/what\-if analysis. The Finance Analyst will build and maintain robust, decision\-ready financial models, run scenario\-based analyses to support pricing and business decisions, and provide the analytical backbone for FP\&A reporting. Advanced Excel modeling skills are essential to this role. The candidate will partner closely with Finance, Solutions, Operations, and leadership to translate business questions into structured financial models and scenarios.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Pricing, Modeling \& Scenario Analysis (Core Focus)** 




 ● Own end\-to\-end financial model development and maintenance, including integrated revenue, expense, and
 



 headcount models.
 



 ● Build and maintain pricing models, including deal\-level and customer\-level pricing analysis.
 



 ● Design and run scenario\-based / what\-if models to evaluate the financial impact of pricing changes, cost
 



 structures, and business decisions.
 



 ● Perform sensitivity analysis on key business drivers (volume, price, cost, mix) to support leadership
 



 decision\-making.
 



 ● Support ad hoc initiatives including pricing strategy, deal evaluation, and acquisition\-related financial
 



 modeling and scenario analysis.
 



 ● Develop and automate dashboards, KPI reporting, and streamlined data flows to support modeling and
 



 scenario work across systems.
 



  





**FP\&A, Reporting \& Planning Support** 




 ● Prepare project\-level cost reporting and insights.
 



 ● Prepare COGS and operating expense (Opex) variance analysis reports.
 



 ● Prepare customer\- and vertical\-level margin reporting.
 



 ● Deliver performance insights and executive\-level reporting, including variance analysis.
 



 ● Manage monthly and quarterly forecasting cycles with cross\-functional alignment.
 



 ● Drive the annual budgeting process in coordination with internal and outsourced accounting teams.
 



 ● Partner across teams to improve data quality, governance, and system integration.
 



  





**Requirements** 




 ● Very strong, hands\-on Excel skills are essential — advanced financial modeling, scenario\-based modeling,
 



 and what\-if analysis (sensitivity tables, data tables, scenario manager, dynamic driver\-based models).
 



 ● Demonstrated experience building pricing models and conducting pricing analysis.
 



 ● Demonstrated expertise in financial modelling, planning systems, and performance reporting.
 



 ● Strong understanding of budgeting cycles, forecasting processes, and financial governance.
 



 ● Strong analytical thinking, accuracy, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs
 



 into scalable financial models and automation.
 



 ● Excellent communication skills, with the ability to partner with senior leadership and cross\-functional
 



 stakeholders.
 



 ● Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment, and collaborate
 



 effectively with outsourced/shared service teams.
 



 ● Experience in healthcare services, and/or PE\-backed environments is an advantage.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 ● Masters degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field.
 



 ● Professional certifications (e.g., CFA, CMA) or an MBA (Finance) are preferred but not required.
 



 ● Subject Matter Expert in Excel — advanced financial modeling, scenario/what\-if analysis, and pricing
 



 models; Google Sheets modeling experience is also acceptable. BI experience (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
 



 is preferred.
 



 ● 5 to 10 years of experience in FP\&A, pricing, strategic finance, or financial modeling roles.

description:
Position 
 Senior Manager Corporate Finance Department 
 Corporate Finance Location 
 Chennai Corporate Office Reports To 
 General Manager Corporate Finance Experience 
 5 to 8 years post qualification Qualification 
 CA / CMA mandatory; MBA Finance preferred 
 ABOUT THE ROLE Pricing, payer contracting and revenue governance at Apollo have largely been managed at the unit level. The group is now bringing these areas under a common corporate framework, and this position is responsible for building that framework and implementing it across the network. 
 Driving technology building and implementation is part of this role. The position works closely with the Technology team to co create and implement solutions at group level that will carry the pricing, contracting and commercial governance processes. 
 The position works closely with the General Manager to build the function, with a team added as the mandate scales. The initial period is hands on, and the work carries direct visibility to the CFO office. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Pricing and Tariff Governance Own the group pricing policy, and maintain version control of tariffs across specialities, service lines and units. Run the annual tariff revision cycle, including the revision model, cost inflation and case mix scenarios, and recommendations with quantified P&L impact. Build and maintain the package and procedure rate library, including package costing and floor prices. Review exception and non standard pricing requests within delegated authority, and escalate with a recommendation. 
 2. Revenue and Commercial Analytics Develop the group view of payer economics covering realisation, discounts and net yield by payer, plan, unit and speciality. Build service line and speciality profitability analytics, including contribution margin, ARPOB, ALOS and case mix. Identify and quantify revenue leakage across unbilled charges, off policy discounts, tariff mapping errors and claim deductions, and follow through on recovery. Prepare pricing models and business cases for new services, capacity additions and equipment proposals, along with competitor benchmarking. Publish the monthly commercial MIS pack for leadership review. 
 3. Payer and Institutional Commercials Maintain the central repository and commercial evaluation of insurer, TPA, corporate and government scheme arrangements, covering rates, terms, exclusions and the renewal calendar. Prepare the commercial case for renewals, including rate benchmarking, volume and margin analysis and deduction history, and participate in negotiations. Monitor contract performance after signature, covering realisation against contracted rates, deduction and denial trends, pre authorisation turnaround and receivable ageing. Standardise commercial terms across the network in coordination with Legal. 
 4. Technology, Systems and Master Data Drive the building and implementation of technology solutions for the function, working with the Technology team from design through to rollout at group level. Co create the solution by translating commercial and governance requirements into system requirements, and remain the finance owner through build, testing and go live. Ensure pricing, contracting and commercial governance processes are carried on system rather than run outside it, including the necessary integration with HIS, ERP and billing. Define and maintain the commercial master data standard for service, tariff, payer and package masters, along with the change control process. Drive adoption across units, and automate recurring analytics and reporting in Power BI or an equivalent tool. 
 CANDIDATE PROFILE Qualification and experience Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant. MBA in Finance preferred. 5 to 8 years of post qualification experience in corporate or commercial finance, FP&A, business finance, pricing or revenue management. Hands on experience in one or more of pricing, contracting, profitability analysis or revenue assurance, with scope that has grown over time. Candidates who have supported these areas and are ready to take ownership will be considered. Experience of working with technology teams to build or implement a system, including defining requirements and testing. Experience in multi location or multi entity organisations is an advantage. Healthcare, diagnostics or insurance and TPA sector experience is preferred but not essential. Technical skills Advanced Excel and financial modelling. This is the core requirement. Exposure to Power BI or an equivalent business intelligence tool, and to SAP or Oracle ERP. Familiarity with hospital information systems and the hospital revenue cycle is an advantage. Working understanding of data structures, master data management and system workflows. Competencies Willingness to set up processes and controls where practice is not yet standardised. Ability to translate a commercial requirement into a system requirement and see it through with a technology team. Effective engagement with unit finance teams, operations, technology and senior leadership without direct reporting authority. Sound commercial judgement, attention to detail and strong execution across concurrent priorities. Clear written and verbal communication, including at leadership forums.

Ensure invoices are processed promptly to support payment cycles and maintain strong vendor relationships. Adhere to internal control procedures and always maintain processing accuracy. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience in invoice processing and accounts payable operations / Travel and Expenses Strong attention to detail and high degree of accuracy in data entry. Ability to identify inconsistencies and resolve issues efficiently. Willingness to work in US Shift timings. Familiarity with invoice processing tools or ERP systems; experience with ERP is an added advantage. Good written communication skills for clear and professional email correspondence.
